outline:
本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters, and 3 lecture hours per week.
schedule:
第1週/1st-Week: Ch-14 Fluids 流體

第2週/2nd-Week: Ch-14 Fluids 流體 + Ch-15 Oscillations 振盪

第3週/3rd-Week: Ch-15 Oscillations 振盪 + Ch-16 Waves-I 波-I

第4週/4th-Week: Ch-16 Waves-I 波-I + Ch-17 Waves-II 波-II

第5週/5th-Week: Ch-21 Coulomb’s Law 庫倫定律 + Ch-22 Electric Fields 電 場

第6週/6th-Week: Ch-22 Electric Fields 電 場 + Ch-23 Gauss’s Law 高斯定理

第7週/7th-Week: Ch-23 Gauss’s Law 高斯定理 + Ch-24 Electric Potential 電位

第8週/8th-Week:Middle-term Examination (期中考)

第9週/9th-Week:Ch-25 Capacitance and Capacitor 電容與電容器 + Ch-26 Current and Resistance 電流與電阻

第10週/10th-Week: Ch-26 Current and Resistance 電流與電阻 + Ch-28 Magnetic Fields (B) 磁場

第11週/11th-Week: Ch-28 Magnetic Fields (B) 磁場 + Ch-29 Magnetic Fields due to Currents 電流所產生的磁場

第12週/12th-Week: Ch-29 Magnetic Fields due to Currents 電流所產生的磁場 + Ch-30 Induction and Inductance

第13週/13th-Week: Ch-30 Induction and Inductance + Ch-32 Maxwell’s Equations (麥克斯威方程式), Magnetism of Matter (物質的磁性)

第14週/14th-Week: Ch-32 Maxwell’s Equations (麥克斯威方程式), Magnetism of Matter (物質的磁性) + Ch-33 Electromagnetic Waves 電磁波

第15週/15th-Week: Ch-33 Electromagnetic Waves 電磁波 + Ch-34 Images 成像

第16週/16th-Week: Ch-34 Images 成像 + Ch-35 Interference 干涉

第17週/18th-Week:Ch-35 Interference 干涉 + Ch-36 Diffraction 繞射 + Ch-38 Photons and Matter Waves 光子與物質波

第18週/18th-Week:Final-term Examination (期末考)
